relationships.subject: voluntary wheel running
relationships.evidence_quote: Rats with access to the running wheels showed beneficial effects on persistent formalin-induced mechanical allodynia and hyperalgesia.

key_findings: Voluntary wheel running produced analgesia against persistent formalin-induced mechanical allodynia and hyperalgesia in rats.
The analgesia was accompanied by suppression of spinal dorsal horn microglial proliferation, TrkB upregulation and KCC2 downregulation, whereas BDNF levels did not appear to mediate the effect.
